_comment: Bands for scripts/bank-check.js. Each is derived from the bank mode spec (project_plan.md in the Betaflight repo), not from a measured run. Same rule as tests/thresholds.json: never widen a band to make a check pass; argue it in PROGRESS.md and let the owner decide. A key with no band here is printed as info.

hover_vertical_accel.why: pitch stick centre is 1 g of lift: zero vertical acceleration (not zero vertical speed, that needs baro)

hover_tilt_deg.why: speed stick at the bottom: no tilt

hover_horizontal_speed.why: speed stick at the bottom commands zero speed

cruise_speed_variation.why: a fixed speed stick holds a steady speed once settled

cruise_vertical_accel.why: tilting forward raises collective by 1/cos so vertical force is unchanged

turn_roll_tracking_deg.why: the craft holds the thrust direction the mode commands

turn_coordination_dps.why: coordinated turn: the nose turns at the rate the track turns

turn_slip_deg.why: the nose follows the track: the slip loop turns it onto the estimated direction of travel (race rewrite in project_plan.md; the head check is a to-do)

turn_vertical_accel.why: bank applies the same 1/cos tilt compensation

brake_final_speed.why: speed stick to the stop (min_check) brakes to a stop

reverse_speed_mps.why: below min_check a small reverse: 10 % of bank_mid_speed (0.05 g of drag, about 2 m/s on the five inch), backwards along the nose

reverse_vertical_accel.why: tilting back to reverse keeps Lift, as any tilt does

reverse_nose_turn_deg.why: backing off a wall with no Bank keeps the nose where it was

reverse_max_tilt_deg.why: a small reverse, within the 30 deg brake angle

reversestop_final_speed.why: back to the stop band (10 % of the stick above min_check) stops the reverse and holds no speed

brakereverse_final_speed_mps.why: the bottom of the stick from the cruise brakes, then carries on into the small reverse

brakereverse_settled_pitch_span_deg.why: a steady reverse: no pitch hunting across the forward to backward flip of the speed estimate

mode_off_cleared.why: switching bank off clears the mode

learned_drag_rate_error.why: the firmware learns the drag rate in flight from its default: within 15 % of the plant's (g * drag reading / airspeed in steady cruise) after the sortie (learned airframe plan in the Betaflight repo's project-docs/plans)

determinism_same_hash.why: same inputs give a bit identical trace

whoop_hover_vertical_accel.why: the whoop, flown from the five inch's defaults with no settings: pitch stick centre is 1 g of lift: zero vertical acceleration (not zero vertical speed, that needs baro)
